verdict.rationale: Replit's core product is designed for natural-language operation — users describe apps, iterate via conversation, and Agent Modes/Agent build, test, and publish based on NL prompts (replit-docs-2, replit-docs-7, replit-docs-25, replit-docs-31). Community testimony corroborates that Replit's 'vibe coding' via NL commands works well for many users (replit-comm-6), though other users report agentic failures/bugs (replit-comm-5, replit-comm-8) which reflect reliability concerns rather than the absence of NL-driven operation. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of NL command accuracy/robustness and more consistent community corroboration free of agent-reliability complaints.
